deliverables.description: Implement the approved small IPresenter.recover contract in existing presenters, nullable processing_error on shared models, normal/recovery schema alternatives and configured notices. Bound Unicode candidate prefixes before encoding. No operation/notes/attachments/context objects or normal data projection enter recovery.

Remember actual outcome before presentation; on later exception pass only outcome, native diagnostic strings and successful cache receipt scalars to one recovery attempt. Preserve original cause/outcome and finite terminal behavior, no second server presenter, payload conversion or side effect retry.

Adapt existing public SDK failure test and directly affected model/profile/config/interface/startup tests. Prove success/failure, reference/null, channel/schema truth, poisoned/large payload independence, bounded Unicode diagnosis and finite recovery; no snapshots/legacy tests or broad test rewrite.

cycles.exit_criteria: Meaningful RED then GREEN evidence for the post-operation defect; compact outcome/notice/bounded-diagnosis/existing-reference recovery conforms to selected schemas/channels without original-payload conversion, normal projection/render retry, publication or retrieval; affected consumers aligned; focused tests and applicable target checks pass; no waiver or new policy.
